mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2C9 and CYP3A4), and nafcillin is metabolized hepatically, potentially increasing nafcillin levels; additionally, disulfiram may increase risk of hepatotoxicity when combined with beta-lactam antibiotics.
action: Monitor liver function tests and nafcillin efficacy; consider alternative antibiotic if hepatic impairment present; counsel patient on continued alcohol abstinence during treatment.
